events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: A New Leaf

options.text: Very well. We will agree to a truce.
[rival] will not be forgiven so easily.

events.text: A messenger arrives from [rival] and is brought before you. Your palace guard watches her every move as she begins "I bring news that [character] has left this world. So begins the reign of [character], and a renewed hope for an end to hostilities between our nations." How will you respond to [character]'s wish to end this War?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Ascension

options.text: Deport all ethnic [rival] from [city].
Throw a celebration of their heritage.
Erect a statue of [character] in [city].

events.text: The ascension of [character] in [rival] has inspired a popular rebellion in the city of [city], known for its many ethnic [rival]. We must do something to address this population's grievances before their fervor spreads.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Duel of Fates

options.text: I will fight. Fetch my armor-bearer.
Does he take me for a fool? I refuse.
He wants war? He will get it.

events.text: [character] has sent a message through secretive back channels. Having heard tales of your wickedness and immorality, he deems your rule illegitimate. He desires a duel. Combat. It is not a question of armies or nations. It is a question of honor.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: End of the Alliance

options.text: So be it.

events.text: With the end of [character]'s reign, our alliance with [rival] is over. Their new ruler, [character], feels that, left unchecked, our nation is now too dangerous.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Invested in Faith

options.text: Send the of your state religion as ambassadors to this new [title].
Thank [character] for the gifts.
Refuse to be influenced by the [religion] [title].

events.text: The new [title] of [rival], [character], is known to be a devout follower of the [religion] faith. It is said that his court has as many as it does ministers. Some of these clergy arrive at your court soon after the foreign leader's coronation, bearing costly gifts of incense. Is it a friendly gesture between rulers or, as your own [religion] priests claim, a plan for his religion to gain influence in your court?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Long Awaited News

options.text: Perhaps I can finally move forward.

events.text: [character] could not escape consequences forever. With his death, perhaps [character] can finally rest at peace.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: No Longer Welcome

options.text: Add [character] to the court.
Send [character] a discreet message on the whereabouts of his wayward courtier.

events.text: [character] now sits on the throne of [rival], and by all accounts, he is all too eager to right any mistakes of [character]. It so happens [character] sees [character] protegee [character] as foremost among those mistakes, which explains [character] appearing to make his case for asylum in [rival].

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Ongoing Alliance

options.text: Please accept this generous gift of gold.
We humble ourselves before mighty [rival].
Our alliance has come to an end.

events.text: With the end of [character]'s reign, our alliance with [rival] is in question. However, word has reached us that [character] is willing to extend our Alliance Player, but only if we show our willingness to honor this special relationship. What shall we tell him?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Persecutions of [city]

options.text: Take as many [religion] refugees as possible.
Send soldiers to escort the fleeing citizens.
Decree your support for the persecutions of the [religion].

events.text: News has reached your court that [city] is in flames, the fires painting the heavens with a dark orange glow. The new ruler [character] has led his people in an attack on the [religion] citizens of [rival], blaming them for the fire and other ills of the nation. The [religion] members of your court ask to send aid to help the people. What will you do?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Power of the Throne

options.text: Have [character] remove the problem.
We should tread carefully with [character].
There is nothing to fear from [character].

events.text: With the abdication of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. There is still mystery around the why [character] chose to abdicate. Your Spymaster [character]’s agents are worried that he could still be acting as the power behind the throne, maneuvering [character] as he sees fit. They suggest being wary in your dealings with [rival] until [character] is gone for good.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Savoring the Moment

options.text: Of course, I shall leave at once.
I'm afraid something has come up. Perhaps when things quiet down.

events.text: At last, it is done. [character] sits on the throne of [rival], and, ecstatic, he has invited you to spend more time at his luxurious palace in [city].

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Something to Remember Them By

options.text: Whether genuine gesture or mockery, the scamp seems harmless enough.
Oh, no [character], you are not getting away with this. You know who really needs joy and companionship right now? Your grieving son, [character].

subjects: Was Leader Dead Owed Favor Them
events.text: The message, purportedly one of the very last to be dictated by [character], reads "I feel there was a debt to you I was never able to repay, so allow me to make one final attempt. May little <p.is_sub.S2=SUBJECT_PLAYER_ASSYRIA>Nimedu<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_BABYLONIA>Shuma<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_CARTHAGE>Shada<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_EGYPT>Pepi<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_GREECE>Derdas<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_PERSIA>Shapur<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_ROME>Gaius<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_HITTITE>Akia<p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_KUSH>Khaliut<else>Popo<end> here provide you with years of joy and companionship." You cast your eyes over to a small cage that arrived with the message, where a monkey is poking a nose inquisitively through the bars, while making a noise several times louder than you would have thought possible from such a tiny creature.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: The Final Favor

options.text: Accept a sizeable donation to your national coffers.
Ask that they keep the favor for the time being.

subjects: Was Leader Dead Owed Favor Them
events.text: At the funeral of [character], you are approached by the new [title] [character] with tears in his eyes and steel in his posture. "I shall not beat around the bush. [character] told me that he owed you a debt. I would see that debt repaid. Will you accept?"

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: The New Face of [rival]

options.text: [city] is of the utmost strategic importance.
If [city] is captured, [rival] forces will be forced into disarray.
[city] is the key to the war, if we can wear down its defenses.
Trust your instincts, they are better than you presume.

events.text: [character] presents an authoritative face, wrapped up in the splendor and august mood of the coronation ceremony. Privately, however, [character] confides to you that military matters are not his forte, and asks for your assessment of the ongoing [rival] war.

events.author: Gabe Campbell
events.name: The Pride of [character]

options.text: Declare a curse upon [character].
We will continue to conduct our war with [rival] as we have done.

events.text: With the welcome of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to the even more vile [character]. At the feast following his succession, [character] is heard loudly boasting of how [rival] stands above all others, especially [rival]. He goes on to describe our noble land in the most acerbic terms, using language that cannot possibly be repeated here. [character] furthermore claims that his loathsome henchmen will soon lay waste to all of [rival] with a renewed war effort. Are these the empty words of a braggart, or something more?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Wheels Without Wheels

options.text: [character] is dead. I will not look a gift horse in the mouth.

outcomes.label: They Must Die They Died Disbelieve Main
They Must Die They Died Disbelieve Fallback

events.text: Yes, no one will ever link [character] death to [rival]. You will grant [character] that. But that the entire surrounding circumstance was orchestrated by [character]'s agents? That would be, well, genius, if true.

events.name: Wheels Without Wheels

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character]

options.text: A new power rises.

events.text: News reaches you from abroad; in a surprising move, [character] has stepped down as the leader of [rival]. [character] has ascended to rule [rival] in his place. <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_PLAYER_ASSYRIA>[character] has been named King in accordance with the succession contract made by [character] and his vassals. Inscriptions of [character]’s might and power are soon being commissioned across [rival]. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_BABYLONIA>He has been appointed King above all others, consecrated for rule by the priests of [city]. Inscriptions of [character]’s protection and piety are soon being raised across [rival]. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_CARTHAGE>He has been elected by the noble houses to serve as King in [character]’s footsteps, leading the people and senate of [rival] into a new age. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_EGYPT>He immediately held the traditional feast appearing as Pharaoh for the first time, starting the year-long chain of rites and events that confirm his role as the new Pharaoh of [rival]. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_GREECE>He was immediately proclaimed King by the nobles and generals upon [character]’s abdication. With the throne secure, [character] is ready to lead the people of [rival]. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_PERSIA>He entered the temple of [city] and changed into the robes previously worn by [character]. After a ritual meal of figs and sour milk, [character] has assumed his new title of King of [rival]. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_ROME>He has been empowered to lead the mighty [rival] and invested with the traditional retinue of twelve lictor bodyguards. They clear the way as [character] takes his seat as the new leader. <p=SUBJECT_PLAYER_HITTITE>He has been named [title], proclaiming his rights to the ancestral lands of the [rival]. Renowned as a child of their storm god, this new ruler could be a force to be wary of. <else>He has been empowered to lead the mighty [rival] into the new age. <end>

events.name: [character]

options.text: May he lead his people to ruin.

His equally contemptible heir [character] has ascended to rule [rival] in his place. <p.is_sub.S0=SUBJECT_PLAYER_ASSYRIA>[character] has been named King in accordance with the succession contract made by [character] and his vassals. events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: [character] Deposed

options.text: Condemn his actions.
Send a gift. It's better to be friends with such a person!
What if I’m next!?

events.text: With the abdication of [character], rule of [rival] has passed to [character]. Rumors are quickly spreading that the abdication was not voluntary. It is supposed that [character] rose up and forced [character] to cede the crown. Your advisors warn that such a bold ruler could be a force to be reckoned with in years to come.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: [rival] Grasp Weakens

options.text: Expel [character].
Now is not the time to antagonize the [rival].

events.text: With the upheaval of [character]'s ascension, [rival] is preoccupied and its foreign policy in a state of flux. [character] cannot, for the moment, rely on the immediate backing of the [rival] army. Therein lies an opportunity, but it is not without risk.
